serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `typescript-language-server` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the TypeScript server the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report type errors and suggestions in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer completions, with the import they need, while typing.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show types and documentation on hover.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show the call signature while typing arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Resolve definitions, type definitions and implementations.

references.title: Find References
references.description: List the uses of a symbol.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document and project symbols to go-to-symbol.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with the file's declarations.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer quick fixes and refactorings in the intentions list.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show the inferred types and parameter names chosen below.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: Show the implementation and reference counts chosen below.

tsserver.title: tsserver
tsserver.description: The TypeScript installation behind the language server, and how it runs.

path.title: TypeScript Path
path.description: Path to a `tsserver.js`, or to the `lib` directory of a TypeScript installation, to use instead of the bundled one. Point this at your project's own `node_modules/typescript` to check against the version the project builds with.

useSyntaxServer.title: Syntax Server
useSyntaxServer.description: Run a second, lighter server for the answers that need only the file itself, so syntax highlighting and folding stay responsive while the main server is busy with a large project.

maxTsServerMemory.title: Memory Limit
maxTsServerMemory.description: Megabytes the server may use. Raise it for a large project that runs out; set to 0 for the Node default.

logVerbosity.title: Log Verbosity
logVerbosity.description: How much tsserver writes to its log, which `ide-client:show-log` opens.

disableAutomaticTypeAcquisition.title: Disable Automatic Type Acquisition
disableAutomaticTypeAcquisition.description: Stop the server downloading `@types` packages for untyped JavaScript dependencies. Turn this on to work offline, or to keep the server from reaching the network at all.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Language for the server's own messages, such as `de` or `ja`. Leave empty for English.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How the server writes the code it inserts.

quotePreference.title: Quote Style
quotePreference.description: Quotes used in an inserted import. `auto` follows what the file already uses.

importModuleSpecifierPreference.title: Import Path Style
importModuleSpecifierPreference.description: The path an inserted import is written with.

importModuleSpecifierEnding.title: Import Path Ending
importModuleSpecifierEnding.description: Whether an inserted import path keeps its file extension. `auto` follows the module settings of the project.

includePackageJsonAutoImports.title: Auto-Import From Dependencies
includePackageJsonAutoImports.description: Offer symbols from the packages in `package.json`. `auto` stops doing so in a project large enough for it to be slow.

preferTypeOnlyAutoImports.title: Prefer Type-Only Imports
preferTypeOnlyAutoImports.description: Insert `import type` when the symbol is only used as a type.

autoImportFileExcludePatterns.title: Auto-Import Exclusions
autoImportFileExcludePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files no auto-import may come from, such as a deprecated module you do not want offered.

jsxAttributeCompletionStyle.title: JSX Attribute Completion
jsxAttributeCompletionStyle.description: What accepting a JSX attribute inserts. `braces` always writes `={}`; `auto` writes quotes for a string attribute and braces otherwise.

maximumHoverLength.title: Maximum Hover Length
maximumHoverLength.description: Characters of a type shown on hover before it is truncated.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Which inferred types and names are rendered inline. The editor's own Inlay Hints setting has to be on as well, and every one of these is off until you turn it on.

parameterNames.title: Parameter Names
parameterNames.description: Show the name of the parameter an argument is passed to. `literals` does so only for a literal argument, where the name is not already visible in the code.

parameterNamesWhenArgumentMatches.title: Parameter Names Matching The Argument
parameterNamesWhenArgumentMatches.description: Show the parameter name even when the argument passed already has that name.

parameterTypes.title: Parameter Types
parameterTypes.description: Show the inferred type of an unannotated function parameter.

variableTypes.title: Variable Types
variableTypes.description: Show the inferred type of an unannotated variable.

variableTypesWhenNameMatches.title: Variable Types Matching The Name
variableTypesWhenNameMatches.description: Show the variable's type even when its name already says it.

propertyDeclarationTypes.title: Property Types
propertyDeclarationTypes.description: Show the inferred type of an unannotated property declaration.

functionReturnTypes.title: Return Types
functionReturnTypes.description: Show the inferred return type of a function with no annotation.

enumMemberValues.title: Enum Member Values
enumMemberValues.description: Show the value an enum member is assigned.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: The counts rendered above a declaration. The editor's own Code Lens setting has to be on as well.

implementations.title: Implementations
implementations.description: Count the implementations of an interface or abstract member.

references.title: References
references.description: Count the uses of a declaration.

referencesOnAllFunctions.title: References On All Functions
referencesOnAllFunctions.description: Count the uses of every function, not only the exported ones.

completeFunctionCalls.title: Complete Function Calls
completeFunctionCalls.description: Accepting a function fills in its parameters as snippet tab stops, rather than inserting the name alone.

ignoredDiagnosticCodes.title: Ignored Diagnostic Codes
ignoredDiagnosticCodes.description: TypeScript error numbers never to report, without the `TS` prefix — `2307` for an unresolved import, say. The number is shown beside every message in the linter.

implicitProjectConfiguration.title: Files Outside A Project
implicitProjectConfiguration.description: Compiler options for a file with no `tsconfig.json` or `jsconfig.json` above it. A file inside a project takes its options from that project and ignores these.

checkJs.title: Check JavaScript
checkJs.description: Type-check JavaScript files, not only TypeScript.

strictNullChecks.title: Strict Null Checks
strictNullChecks.description: Treat `null` and `undefined` as distinct from every other type.

strictFunctionTypes.title: Strict Function Types
strictFunctionTypes.description: Check function parameters contravariantly, which rejects an unsound assignment.

target.title: Target
target.description: The JavaScript version the code is written for.

module.title: Module
module.description: The module system the code is written for.
